svg.title: Scout Rev B assembly overview
svg.desc: Fusion exploded view with chassis, motors, clamps, wheels, carrier board, tail skid and bumper callouts. Current Carrier C populated-board clearance requires a physical check.

g.text: Rev B · integral chassis · M3 hardware
Actual Fusion export. Battery and holder omitted. Board shown is the Rev B mechanical reference.
Screw lengths are measured under the head. Full assembly sequence and physical checks: Scout Build guide.
